name: Database Migration with Validation
description: Deterministic SurrealDB migration activity with version tracking, pre-migration backup query, validation, and rollback support. Uses bash resolvers for reliability with proper error handling and dry-run support.

variables.name: specificFile
variables.description: Run only this specific migration file (leave empty to run all)

variables.name: dryRun
variables.description: Show what would be executed without running migrations

tasks.description: Validate migration directory and SurrealDB connectivity

config.command: set -e; echo '=== Validating Prerequisites ==='; if [ ! -d '{{migrationDir}}' ]; then echo "ERROR: Migration directory not found: {{migrationDir}}"; exit 1; fi; MIGRATION_COUNT=$(find '{{migrationDir}}' -maxdepth 1 -name '*.surql' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "Found $MIGRATION_COUNT migration files"; if [ "$MIGRATION_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'WARNING: No .surql files found in migration directory'; fi; echo 'Testing SurrealDB connectivity...'; HEALTH=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 5 '{{surrealUrl}}/health' 2>/dev/null || echo '000'); if [ "$HEALTH" != '200' ]; then echo "ERROR: Cannot connect to SurrealDB at {{surrealUrl}} (HTTP $HEALTH)"; exit 1; fi; echo 'SurrealDB connection OK'; echo 'Prerequisites validated'

tasks.description: List migration files to be executed in order

config.command: set -e; cd '{{migrationDir}}'; echo '=== Migration Files ==='; SPECIFIC='{{specificFile}}'; if [ -n "$SPECIFIC" ]; then if [ -f "$SPECIFIC" ]; then echo "Single file mode: $SPECIFIC"; ls -la "$SPECIFIC"; else echo "ERROR: Specified file not found: $SPECIFIC"; exit 1; fi; else echo 'All migrations (sorted by filename):'; ls -1 *.surql 2>/dev/null | sort -V || echo 'No .surql files found'; fi

tasks.description: Backup current schema state before migration

config.command: DRY='{{dryRun}}'; if [ "$DRY" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: dryRun=true - no backup needed'; exit 0; fi; set -e; mkdir -p '{{backupDir}}'; TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); BACKUP_FILE='{{backupDir}}/schema-backup-$TIMESTAMP.txt'; echo '=== Backing up current schema state ==='; curl -s -X POST '{{surrealUrl}}/sql' -u '{{username}}:{{password}}' -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' -H 'surreal-ns: {{namespace}}' -H 'surreal-db: {{database}}' -H 'Accept: application/json' -d 'INFO FOR DB;' > "$BACKUP_FILE" 2>&1 || { echo 'WARNING: Failed to backup schema (database may not exist yet)'; echo '{}' > "$BACKUP_FILE"; }; echo "Schema backup saved to: $BACKUP_FILE"; wc -c < "$BACKUP_FILE" | xargs -I {} echo 'Backup size: {} bytes'

DRY='{{dryRun}}'; cd '{{migrationDir}}'; SPECIFIC='{{specificFile}}'; echo '=== Running Migrations ==='; if [ -n "$SPECIFIC" ]; then FILES="$SPECIFIC"; else FILES=$(ls -1 *.surql 2>/dev/null | sort -V || echo ''); fi; if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then echo 'No migration files to run'; exit 0; fi; SUCCESS_COUNT=0; FAIL_COUNT=0; for FILE in $FILES; do echo "--- Processing: $FILE ---"; if [ "$DRY" = 'true' ]; then echo 'DRY RUN: Would execute:'; head -20 "$FILE"; echo '... (truncated)'; SUCCESS_COUNT=$((SUCCESS_COUNT + 1)); continue; fi; RESULT=$(curl -s -X POST '{{surrealUrl}}/sql' -u '{{username}}:{{password}}' -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' -H 'surreal-ns: {{namespace}}' -H 'surreal-db: {{database}}' -H 'Accept: application/json' --data-binary @"$FILE" 2>&1); if echo "$RESULT" | grep -qi 'error\|failed'; then echo "ERROR in $FILE:"; echo "$RESULT" | head -20; FAIL_COUNT=$((FAIL_COUNT + 1)); else echo "OK: $FILE"; SUCCESS_COUNT=$((SUCCESS_COUNT + 1)); fi; done; echo ''; echo "=== Migration Summary ==="; echo "Successful: $SUCCESS_COUNT"; echo "Failed: $FAIL_COUNT"; if [ "$FAIL_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then echo 'WARNING: Some migrations failed'; exit 1; fi

tasks.description: Validate schema after migration by querying table info

config.command: SKIP='{{skipValidation}}'; DRY='{{dryRun}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipValidation=true'; exit 0; fi; if [ "$DRY" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: dryRun=true - no validation needed'; exit 0; fi; set -e; echo '=== Validating Schema ==='; RESULT=$(curl -s -X POST '{{surrealUrl}}/sql' -u '{{username}}:{{password}}' -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' -H 'surreal-ns: {{namespace}}' -H 'surreal-db: {{database}}' -H 'Accept: application/json' -d 'INFO FOR DB;' 2>&1); if echo "$RESULT" | grep -qi 'error'; then echo 'ERROR: Failed to query database info'; echo "$RESULT"; exit 1; fi; echo 'Database info retrieved successfully'; echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.[0].result.tables | keys[]' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -30 || echo 'Tables: (could not parse)'; TABLES=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.[0].result.tables | length' 2>/dev/null || echo '0'); echo "Total tables: $TABLES"; if [ "$TABLES" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'WARNING: No tables found after migration'; fi; echo 'Schema validation completed'

tasks.description: Verify critical tables exist and have correct structure

config.command: SKIP='{{skipValidation}}'; DRY='{{dryRun}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipValidation=true'; exit 0; fi; if [ "$DRY" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: dryRun=true'; exit 0; fi; echo '=== Verifying Key Tables ==='; KEY_TABLES='activity impulse execution vessel activity_template'; for TABLE in $KEY_TABLES; do echo "Checking table: $TABLE"; RESULT=$(curl -s -X POST '{{surrealUrl}}/sql' -u '{{username}}:{{password}}' -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' -H 'surreal-ns: {{namespace}}' -H 'surreal-db: {{database}}' -H 'Accept: application/json' -d "INFO FOR TABLE $TABLE;" 2>&1); if echo "$RESULT" | grep -qi 'error\|not exist'; then echo "WARNING: Table $TABLE may not exist or has issues"; else FIELDS=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.[0].result.fields | length' 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); echo "OK: $TABLE (fields: $FIELDS)"; fi; done; echo 'Key table verification completed'

features: Deterministic bash execution - no LLM needed
Proper error handling with exit codes
